text:
Alex Kim: Quick heads-up — I'm putting together the release notes for 2.3.0 and the internal announce. Change window target: Wed 23:00 UTC (2h blackout). Need ops pin + canary plan.
Maria Sanchez: Thanks — can you paste the short TL;DR we want in the internal blurb? keeping it one paragraph for the ops digest.
Alex Kim: TL;DR: improves inference batching, fixes memory leak on long-context sessions, adds pinned quantized v2 model for lower-cost serving. Will include rollback criteria and deploybot cues.
Jamal Reed: For canary, prefer 5% traffic to dedicated pool then 25% after smoke. Can we pin traffic by route?
Priya Patel: Yes, routing policy exists — we'll map 5% to dedicated-canary pool, fallback to hosted-std. I'll update the rollout config.
Alex Kim: Ok adding snippet: `canary: {start: 2026-03-25T23:00:00Z, phases: [5,25,100], health_checks: [latency_p50 < 150ms, error_rate < 0.5%]}`
Taylor Wu: Heads-up for comms: include the model version string (model=redwood/falcon-q8-v2.1) and mention cost savings estimate (~18%). Keep legal/PII line: no user-visible prompt changes.
Sam O'Neill: Oncall will be Sam for the window; Jamal will shadow for canary. I can pick up midnight handoff for APAC.
Maria Sanchez: Draft internal announce (one-liner + bullets) — posting below for quick edit: "Release 2.3.0 — performance + cost optimizations. Deploy Wed 23:00 UTC. Canary 5% -> 25% -> 100%. Rollback triggered if error_rate > 0.5% or p50 latency regresses > 30ms."
Alex Kim: That reads well. Add the deploybot commands and rollback playbook link.
Jamal Reed: DeployBot: can we run a dry-run now so the deploybot cues in the channel during window?
DeployBot: dry-run scheduled by Jamal Reed. Steps: 1) canary create (model=redwood/falcon-q8-v2.1), 2) canary route 5%, 3) smoke tests. Use `/deploy start --dry-run 9965432100`
Priya Patel: I'll push updated rollout config to the infra repo and add the pinned-version note: `pin: redwood/falcon-q8-v2.1@2026-03-25`
Taylor Wu: Internal announce copy suggestion: "Heads-up: We will deploy 2.3.0 on Wed 23:00 UTC. Expect a brief canary followed by a full rollout. No user-facing behavior changes expected. Oncall: Sam. See pinned model and rollback criteria below." Keep it short.
Maria Sanchez: Can someone confirm the rollback owner and manual steps? We should list a single owner and an immediate command to trigger rollback.
Jamal Reed: Rollback owner: Jamal. Manual rollback command: `/deploy rollback --to previous-snapshot 9965432099` — that'll flip routing and demote canary.
Sam O'Neill: I also want an automated fallback: if error_rate spike detected, auto-scale down canary to 0% and send page. Jamal, can you enable that threshold?
Jamal Reed: Yep — set auto-fallback: error_rate > 0.5% for 3m => rollback. I'll commit rule.
Alex Kim: Great. Maria, once you finish annealing the internal copy I'll pin it in the ops digest channel.
Maria Sanchez: Draft done and pasted to #eng-releases-digest — pinging ops. Copy: "Release 2.3.0 (Wed 23:00 UTC) — Performance optimizations and cost improvements. Canary rollout: 5% -> 25% -> 100%. Rollback on error_rate > 0.5% or latency p50 regression > 30ms. Oncall: Sam O'Neill. Rollback owner: Jamal Reed. DeployBot dry-run executed. See infra/playbooks/release-2.3.0.md for runbook."
Priya Patel: Small note — include the pinned quantized model artifact hash to avoid ambiguity. I'll add `artifact: sha256:ab12...cdef` to the playbook.
Taylor Wu: Also add a short 'what to watch' list for the console: token-cost per-request, p50 latency, host GPU memory usage.
Alex Kim: Final checklist for Wed: 1) Maria publishes internal blurb at T-1h 2) Priya pushes rollout config 3) Jamal runs deploybot dry-run & enables auto-fallback 4) Sam stands by oncall 5) Taylor confirms product copy is cleared.
Sam O'Neill: I'll be in the channel at T-30m and oncall pager at T+0. :thumbsup:
DeployBot: canary create acknowledged. Dry-run OK. Reminder: during live deploy use `/deploy start --thread 9965432100`
Maria Sanchez: Publishing internal announce now (pinned). Thanks everyone — will follow up with post-deploy summary in this thread.
Alex Kim: Thanks — leaving the thread open for standby notes and immediate post-deploy results.
Jamal Reed: If anything goes sideways I'll post timeline and next steps here.
Priya Patel: committing the config now. PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/1723
Maria Sanchez: noted, closing prep loop. Last message before window.
Alex Kim: Last: add a line to the internal blurb: "If you are on a routing/traffic-sensitive team and see any anomalies, DM Jamal or @sam oncall."
Maria Sanchez: Done. :white_check_mark:
